description: This file defines the ResourceGroupsTaggingAPIClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Resource Groups Tagging API service. It specifies various methods for operations like describing report creation, getting compliance summaries, managing tags on resources, etc.

classes.name: ResourceGroupsTaggingAPIClient
classes.description: A client class that interacts with AWS Resource Groups Tagging API, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: describeReportCreation
methods.description: Performs the describeReportCreation API call, returning details about report creation status.

methods.name: describeReportCreationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously performs the describeReportCreation API call.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Lists resources based on tags or other criteria.

methods.name: getTagKeys
methods.description: Retrieves tag keys that are available for resources.

methods.name: getTagValues
methods.description: Retrieves tag values for a specific tag key.

methods.name: startReportCreation
methods.description: Initiates a report creation process for resource compliance.
